subject: NovaFin: evidence intake & retention constraints
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samuel Reed <sam.reed@novafin.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Jun 2027 18:12:00 +0000
Subject: NovaFin: evidence intake & retention constraints

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the time earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned and to make the next steps explicit for your legal/compliance team: 

Key pain points you called out:
- SOC 2 coverage and timeline: you need confirmation of Redwood’s current SOC 2 scope and the expected date for the next audit window.
- Audit log retention: NovaFin requires immutable audit logs stored for a minimum of 7 years for certain transaction types; we discussed options for log export and long-term retention.
- DPA/data flows: legal requested a redline of our DPA showing processing locations and subprocessors.
- Pen test artifacts: risk team wants either the latest pen test report or a vendor-validated summary with CVE remediation statuses.

What Redwood will provide (high level):
1) Security Pack: SOC 2 summary page, SOC 2 auditor contact, and our controls mapping — attaching the high-level summary now (redwood_Security-Pack-summary.pdf).
2) Audit logs: two options — (A) daily export to your S3 with lifecycle policies you manage, or (B) Redwood-managed cold storage (costed separately). We’ll include an architecture diagram in the follow-up.
3) DPA redline: we’ll send an annotated DPA for legal to review — will upload a draft today.
4) Pen test: an excerpted report showing critical/high findings and remediation dates; full vendor report requires an NDA in some cases.

Requested items from NovaFin (to help us scope timeline and costs):
- Which data classes require the 7-year retention? a representative list (payment transactions, settlement logs, PII events, etc.).
- Point of contact for legal/compliance who will own the DPA review (email + preferred SLAs for turnaround).
- Any specific region/data residency constraints beyond US (e.g., secondary EU/DE storage).

Next steps (proposed):
- I’ll upload the DPA redline and Audit log architecture draft by EOD tomorrow (attach: DPA_redline_v1.docx).
- We’ll schedule a 45-minute technical demo for your infra team to show the S3 export and retention controls — proposed slots in related links.
- If helpful, I can loop in our Risk lead (Vivek) to walk through the pen test artifacts and acceptance criteria.

Attachments: redwood_Security-Pack-summary.pdf

Thanks — we’ll aim to keep this tight so you can present to legal/ops next week.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

From: Samuel Reed <sam.reed@novafin.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: NovaFin Compliance <compliance@novafin.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Jun 2027 19:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: NovaFin: evidence intake & retention constraints

Priya —

Great summary, thanks. Confirming the high-level asks from our side: 
- Data classes requiring 7-year retention: settlement records, reconciliations, and any transaction-level PII tied to chargebacks. I’ll send a spreadsheet with the exact event list (attached).
- Compliance POC: myself (sam.reed@novafin.com) and our Head of Legal copied on follow ups (they asked to be copied after you send the DPA redline).
- Pen test expectation: we don’t need the raw vendor output initially — a concise remediation matrix with CVE IDs and remediation dates will work for triage. If we move forward, legal may request the full vendor report under NDA.

I’ve attached our questionnaire and an export sample spec for audit logs (NovaFin_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx).

We can do a technical session next Tuesday 2027-06-08 between 14:00-16:00 ET. The demo link you proposed looks good; please confirm and block.

Thanks,
Sam
Samuel Reed
Head of Risk & Compliance, NovaFin
sam.reed@novafin.com
+1 (617) 555-0212

Attachments: NovaFin_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samuel Reed <sam.reed@novafin.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, NovaFin Compliance <compliance@novafin.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 09:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: NovaFin: evidence intake & retention constraints

Sam —

Appreciate the quick reply and the questionnaire — that’s very helpful. Short actionable plan based on your note: 

1) DPA redline: attaching draft (DPA_redline_v1.docx). Karthik will own the legal redline responses; expect an updated DPA + summary of changes by Wed 2027-06-09.
2) Audit logs: we’ll prepare two artifacts by Tue 2027-06-08 — (a) architecture diagram for S3 export + lifecycle, (b) sample log schema and retention policy template you can drop into your infra runbook.
3) Pen test excerpt: Vivek will provide a remediation matrix (pen_test_report_excerpt.pdf) showing recent critical/high items and closure dates. Full report available under NDA.
4) Demo slot: confirming Tue 2027-06-08 14:30 ET for the technical demo (45 minutes). Invite sent via calendar; link in related links.

For scope/costing: long-term cold storage (Redwood-managed) will be a separate line item; we’ll provide rough estimates in the architecture doc. If you prefer S3 export under your account, that avoids the managed-storage fees.

If you need anything faster (legal wants tracked redline now), flag it and we’ll prioritize.

Thanks — look forward to the demo.

Best,
Priya
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: DPA_redline_v1.docx

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samuel Reed <sam.reed@novafin.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 21:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: NovaFin: evidence intake & retention constraints

Sam / Priya —

Quick note from Risk: I’ll own the pen-test remediation matrix and confirm which vendor artifacts we can share without an NDA. I’ll upload the excerpt and timeline to the Drive folder by EOD Monday 2027-06-07.

Also — if NovaFin wants to test retention on a pilot dataset (to validate export + restore), we can provision a short-lived Dedicated node to run a 48-hour export/restore trial. Priya/Karthik can walk you through costs in the demo.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Risk & Product Security, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: pen_test_report_excerpt.pdf
